title: CVEs published or modified in the last 24 hours (NVD)
notice: This product uses the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD.

provenance.by: sources/nvd-cve/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: NVD API Terms of Use: the API is for building a service to "search, display, analyze, retrieve, view and otherwise get" NVD data; asked to display "This product uses the NVD API but is not endorsed or certified by the NVD."; the NVD name may identify the source but not imply endorsement; if you modify the content you may not attribute it to the NVD (our totals are ours, our per-CVE values are kept as served); public rate limit 5 requests in a rolling 30 seconds without a key (we use none, seven seconds apart); no more than once every two hours (we read every 6 hours). Not reviewed by a person.

about: CVEs that NVD published or modified in the 24 hours before the read: each with its CNA (the domain of NVD's sourceIdentifier, never the address), status, CVSS base severity and score, weakness types and the vendors and products (NVD's CPE configurations, else the CNA's own list in the same record, marked products_from); and totals per day and severity (daily, and daily_totals for 30 days, complete true only for a whole UTC day). Values are NVD's, kept as served; the totals are ours, counted from them. Descriptions and references are not kept. Vulnerabilities in products, never a victim, host or address. A weak signal, not an audit.
